title: Puzzle 3d Vortex Only Select
description: When clicking on a vortex in puzzle 3d, only the vortex should be selected. Currently the parent object is also marked in 3d as selected.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3D vortex click selection so parent objects no longer receive mesh selected styling when only a vortex is in the selection snapshot. `isObjectSelected` now checks direct `objectIds` only; relocate gizmo still uses `primaryObjectId` (parent of selected vortex). Updated `objectMatchesSelection` and selection store tests.
